description: One load (ADR-0009): the model's load_skill call for a catalogued skill, the skill_loaded event between the call and its result (the skill as a load names it, tool-offer.json#/$defs/loadedSkill, never its instructions, and its bytes, skill.json#/$defs/bytes), and the result: load_skill's answer on a model wire, its effect plan so it is not framed. block is what every later request carries after the history, in the execution state, under the run's marker (marker): the heading that ranks a skill's instructions with the project's own and after them, the skill framed with its instructions and its resource, and the end line. Written by hand; skills.test.ts and go/context hold SkillGate to each.
block:
